title: Coverage: Scheduled Task Forensics - Hidden Tasks Detection
problem: Scheduled task enumeration misses tasks hidden via registry obfuscation or run-once cleanup. Need complete task inventory.
evidence: Task Scheduler UI shows different count than Get-ScheduledTask
cause: Get-ScheduledTask only reads active tasks. Hidden/obfuscated tasks in registry not enumerated.

recommended_actions.action: Add registry-level scheduled task enumeration for hidden tasks

lesson_learned: Registry-level enumeration catches most hidden tasks but highly obfuscated tasks still require advanced persistence analysis. Detection difficulty increases with obfuscation complexity.
